description: This PHP source file provides utility functions for handling input validation (such as printable characters, IP addresses, MAC addresses, URLs, ports, IDs, time, days, SSID names), includes a CSRF protection library, and contains session and locale initialization. It supports various validation routines used across the 'actionHandler' folder in the project.

methods.name: printableCharacters
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only printable ASCII characters within an optional specified range.

methods.name: noSpace
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains at least one non-whitespace character.

methods.name: validIPAddr
methods.description: Validates whether the given IP address string is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

methods.name: validLink
methods.description: Validates a string as a valid URL per URL syntax rules.

methods.name: validMAC
methods.description: Checks if the input string is a valid MAC address, excluding all zeros and ensuring the first byte is even.

methods.name: validPort
methods.description: Verifies if the port number is within the valid range 1-65535.

methods.name: validId
methods.description: Checks if the ID is in the range 1-256.

methods.name: validId_PC
methods.description: Validates parental control IDs, supporting formats like '10' or '10_12'.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in an array.

methods.name: isValInRange
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within a specified minimum and maximum range.

methods.name: validURL
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of URLs, including IPv4, IPv6, and full URL syntax using regular expressions.

methods.name: validTime
methods.description: Validates that startTime is earlier than endTime and both are in valid 00:00-23:59 time format.

methods.name: validDays
methods.description: Validates that the input string contains only days from the list (Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun).

methods.name: valid_ssid_name
methods.description: Validates SSID names for length, reserved keywords, and invalid characters.

methods.name: is_allowed_string
methods.description: Checks if a string does not contain certain invalid characters.

methods.name: remove_special_char
methods.description: Checks if a string does not contain certain special characters.
